text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало grabs first place in the Satsuki
Sho, the
first of three races in the Classic
Triple Crown
tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Some fans expect nothing less from "her
mother's
daughter," but those words of
praise mean
nothing to Кинг Хало as she
leaves them behind
to march forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If she can keep this up, she'll claim first
place in
the renowned Japanese Derby.
With such a
victory, the crowd will have
no choice but to
recognize her for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
